name: 19087 · Wayne, PA
findings: ZIP 19087 (Wayne) has 334 nonprofit organizations. 150 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19087 (Wayne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19087 (Wayne) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 74 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
